name: com.oauth.huaweibranch.view.tips.oneSDKTipsView
description: The CIBMall Huawei Branch account SDK uses this page for guest sign-in, account removal, or nickname changes, depending on the requested account action. Its confirmation button continues the selected request.
disableEffect: Disabling it blocks these Huawei Branch guest sign-in, account-removal, and nickname-change prompts.
